info.title: Catalog & PIM API
info.description: Mode C API of Catalog & PIM (SSPS v1). All data lives in the merchant's own database. Prices are integer minor units in the catalog's (or the item's) currency. Times are ISO-8601 UTC. Errors are RFC 9457 problems (`type` ends with a stable code). POSTs that create or move state require `Idempotency-Key`. `pk_` keys (browsers, domain-locked) read public data only — never cost — with public cache headers; `sk_` keys (servers) need the `api` element: every resource, writes (api.allow_writes), private cost (api.expose_cost), metered per request (unit `request`). Standard events published: item.created@1, item.updated@1, item.deleted@1, inventory.changed@1, price.changed@1.

get.summary: Items. pk_: public items (visible status, inside the publication window) as PublicItem; sk_: every item as OwnerItem (needs the api element; metered).

Cache-Control.description: public, max-age=items.cache_seconds for pk_; no-store for sk_.

post.summary: Create an item of any type, with variants (or the single-variant shorthand price/sku/quantity) and media. The id derives from the Idempotency-Key. Publishes item.created@1.

get.summary: One item by id or slug (pk_: public items only).

Cache-Control.description: public, max-age=items.cache_seconds for pk_; no-store for sk_.

patch.summary: JSON Merge Patch of the item-level fields (variants and media have their own resources). Publishes item.updated@1 with the changed fields.

post.summary: Add a variant to an item (checks dimensions, option pool, uniqueness and SKUs). Publishes item.updated@1 and inventory.changed@1.

patch.summary: JSON Merge Patch of a variant. Publishes price.changed@1 and inventory.changed@1 when they change.

post.summary: Adjust (delta) or set (quantity) stock, optionally guarded by expectedQuantity. Publishes inventory.changed@1.

Reserve stock atomically for a checkout: every line is taken or none (insufficient_stock). An order.placed@1 with the same orderId converts it; otherwise it is released after variants.reservation_ttl_minutes.

CSV import: dryRun (default true) returns the diff and row errors; apply with dryRun false and the dry run's versions as expectedVersions (conflictPolicy skip, overwrite or fail). Prices in major units.

websiteKey.description: pk_ (browser, domain-locked) or sk_ (server) website key

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Optional on POSTs that create records or move stock: ids derive from it, and a repeated key within 24 h is refused with 409 duplicate_request.

FilterAttr.name: filter[attr.<key>]
FilterAttr.description: Facet filter: comma-separated option values (OR within a key, AND across keys). `filter[<key>]` works too for any attribute key that is not a reserved filter name.

Q.name: q
Q.description: Words (up to 5); each must start a word of the item's title, SKUs or tags (accents and case ignored). Full-text search belongs to Site Search.

Page.name: page
Page.description: Offset pages instead of the cursor: the response has page, next (the next page number or null) and total.

Include.name: include
Include.description: Comma-separated: facets (attribute facet counts and the price range of the listed items), total.

Ref.name: ref
Ref.description: Id or slug (old slugs resolve and answer redirectFrom).

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: The item version you read; a different current version answers 412 version_mismatch.

PublicItem.description: An item as shoppers see it (pk_): public items only, public custom fields, stock as a state; never cost.

OwnerItem.description: An item for the merchant (sk_): every field; variant cost only with api.expose_cost.

cost.description: Private: never returned to pk_ keys, never published.

key.description: Object key in the merchant's storage.

options.description: Variant dimensions (attribute keys of variantOption attributes).

price.description: Create only: shorthand for a single variant (with sku, barcode, quantity, compareAtPrice, cost).
